security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG, if the helper for FCVT.D.S (double-precision to single-precision float conversion) or other float-to-float FCVT.*.S instructions incorrectly applies the int_conv table's integer-clipping behavior (e.g., saturating out-of-range float inputs to INT32_MIN/INT32_MAX instead of rounding to the nearest representable float and setting NV), the emulation violates the spec. This can occur if the opcode dispatch in target/riscv/insn_trans/trans_rvzfh.c.inc or similar trans files routes float-to-float FCVT instructions through the same code path as float-to-integer FCVT instructions that follow norm:fcvt_int_float_valid_input.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: gen_helper_fcvt.* opcode dispatch conflating float-to-float with float-to-integer conversion paths; missing distinction between FCVT.D.S/FCVT.S.D/FCVT.H.S and FCVT.W[U].S/FCVT.L[U].S in trans_ functions; int_conv saturation logic applied to non-integer destination formats
security_spec.summary: Spec clarifies that int_conv valid-input/saturation rules apply only to float-to-integer FCVT variants (W[U]/L[U].S), not float-to-float FCVT.D.S; QEMU TCG must not apply integer-clipping (e.g., saturating to INT32_MIN/INT32_MAX) to float-to-float conversions, which would corrupt guest FP state
